name: Integrity
message: Recognize colleagues who demonstrate unwavering honesty, ethical behavior, and strong moral principles in everything they do. Integrity is the foundation of trust in our workplace.

name: Diversity
message: Celebrate the power of diverse perspectives, backgrounds, and experiences. Recognize those who champion inclusivity and create an environment where everyone feels valued and can thrive.

name: Excellence
message: Honor those who consistently go above and beyond, setting high standards and delivering outstanding results. Excellence is about striving for continuous improvement and inspiring others.

name: Collaboration
message: Appreciate team members who excel at working together, fostering open communication, and building strong partnerships that drive collective success.

name: Engagement
message: Recognize colleagues who show exceptional commitment, enthusiasm, and active participation in their work and team initiatives. Their engagement inspires and energizes everyone around them.

name: Green Week
message: Celebrate sustainability with us during Green Week! This week is all about raising environmental awareness and inspiring eco-friendly habits through interactive workshops, green challenges, and community initiatives. Let’s come together to make a positive impact—one action at a time.
